table.claim: cast shadow on open ground is the OTHER dark family, not the same blue
table.scene: shipped Leaf Nine, gameplay camera at spawn
table.note: 206 up-facing terrain samples inside the terrain's own ownership mask, 197 of them reached by the key. Shadowed witness: 9 samples the terrain's own sun march says are blocked, median hue 138 S 0.16 Y 0.0445. Lit witness: undefined samples, hue 27.4 Y 0.1904 at N·L 0.59. §3.4's second family exists only if a CAST shadow leaves an up-facing facet at its own albedo under the blue fill — Terrain's grade now multiplies the lit colour by Materials.castShadowRatio() (ground.shadow / ground.lit) where the map says the key is blocked, instead of sending it to the turned-face tint, which read hue 204.
